title: Reconcile, classify, and release the baseline

classificationRules.reproduced: The frozen claim-level rule passed at its named evidence layer. This never upgrades clean-room R evidence into historical publication evidence.
classificationRules.approximately_reproduced: The frozen numerical or qualitative approximation rule passed but exact/display-level agreement did not.
classificationRules.implementation_sensitive: The claim changes across a frozen metric, backend, formula, placement, composition, or stopping interpretation, or a composite claim has mixed sub-decisions.
classificationRules.not_reproduced: The frozen claim-level rule failed or the result reversed the paper target under the named evidence layer.
classificationRules.not_testable: The claim is non-empirical or required evidence is unavailable and no clean-room test can answer the registered statement without substitution.

evidencePrecedence: Preserve the S01 paper claim and evidence status without rewriting contradictions.
Report frozen-public-commit C evidence separately and never call public HEAD the publication snapshot.
Use clean-room R as the primary executable evidence only where the downstream step preregistered that role.
Keep exact-legacy and corrected-without-replacement placement results separate.
Keep strict paper Sortedness and non-strict duplicate Sortedness separate.
Treat event-budget termination as censoring, never quiescence or stability.
Do not substitute regenerated arrays, streams, endpoints, or figures for missing historical files.

sourcePackaging.reason: Repository-backed source must remain in Git under AGENTS.md, the repository has no license file, and frozen public source has no identified redistribution grant.
sourcePackaging.replacement: Immutable pushed Git commit pointer plus per-file SHA-256 and Git blob manifest.
